findings.message: Codex review of TASK-040 confirms all acceptance criteria are met. Deployment configuration with feature flags is complete and properly secured.
Explicit experimental rollout flags (ai_experimental_tools, ai_beta_features) in deployment defaults provide clear control over experimental AI capabilities, enabling gradual rollout.
CHOYCE_FEATURE_OVERRIDES environment variable provides runtime configuration flexibility with JSON and CSV parsing support, allowing deployment-specific feature customization.
Strict hard-disable enforcement is properly implemented: restricted mode flags cannot be force-enabled by overrides, preventing potential security bypasses via environment manipulation.
Robust CHOYCE_DEPLOYMENT_MODE parsing with aliases provides flexible deployment environment configuration without compromising type safety or validation.
Deployment and feature-flag checks are properly tested via ApplicationTest. test_feature_flag_service.gd validates flag behavior, run_application_tests.gd includes deployment profile validation.
Quality gate suite passes completely: run-application-suite.sh (exit 0) and run-quality-gates.sh (exit 0) confirm no regressions from deployment/feature-flag changes.

Safety implications of env-based overrides have been reviewed. Mode-default policy expectations are confirmed: overrides can customize but cannot bypass safety restrictions or enable restricted modes.

summary: APPROVE. TASK-040 implementation and codex review are both complete and correct. Deployment presets with feature flags for experimental AI capabilities are fully operational. All acceptance criteria are met. Safety implications of env-based overrides confirmed safe. The copilot cross review confirms all findings and validates the implementation.
